command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git reset --hard origin/integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "6b1abf3746168e27ee01272fa9a1267fd306d6bd" ]
printf '%s\n' '=== humidity ==='
sed -n '1,150p' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/rel_humidity_measurement_desc.h
printf '%s\n' '=== occupancy ==='
sed -n '1,210p' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/occupancy_sensing_desc.h
printf '%s\n' '=== onoff desc/cmd ==='
sed -n '1,210p' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/on_off_desc.h
sed -n '1,180p' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/on_off.h
printf '%s\n' '=== level desc/cmd ==='
sed -n '1,220p' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/level_desc.h
sed -n '1,260p' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/level.h
printf '%s\n' '=== zcl core command callbacks ==='
sed -n '1,180p' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/zcl_core.h
grep -R -n -B10 -A25 -E 'on.?off.*message|level.*message|command.*message|cluster.*command.*callback|EZB_ZCL_CORE_.*CMD' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl | head -n 320
